# Copilot instructions

Work in this repository according to `AGENTS.md`.

Read `MEMORY.md` for project history and `DECISIONS.md` for durable technical
choices before changing architecture. Keep these documents factual and update
them when a decision or implementation state changes.

Never include sensitive certificate data or user media in commits. For Arcade
changes, preserve original archive filenames and test FBNeo asset delivery
without assuming ROMsets are interchangeable across MAME revisions.
